source: Live TallyPrime Silver 7.1 read of the synthetic company BRIDGE OUTSTANDINGS LAB, seeded for #945: one request of an `outstandings` party-detail call made through a debug `bridge_mcp` built from commit 3f097e8654bb389126b7e7a0002d0cc8cce2601f (binary sha256 6b3ecf49c54ed5a2ed93c04a94ad819fe86ae69a13145293c290862dba0d303a), recorded by a serial read-only relay between the binary and the gateway
content: 17 vouchers in the window 20250420 to 20260630 (the requested dates) with every ledger entry and bill allocation (34 entries, 34 allocation lists), as Tally returned them.
provenance_limit: One synthetic book on one build, seeded by this project over raw import (15 ledgers, 20 vouchers), so the capture shows how Tally answers these requests for those shapes; it is not evidence about a client's book. The request is the one Bridge itself sent during the tool call. Bridge sent it 2 times, in the `bill_trail` call only (a paired read). Every answer to it was byte-identical to this one.
sensitivity_review: Synthetic company name, synthetic ledger names (prefix OL), synthetic GUIDs; no party, person, GSTIN, address or credential.
